api/MakesCentsBackend.Controllers.html.title: Namespace MakesCentsBackend.Controllers | MakesCents
api/MakesCentsBackend.Controllers.html.summary: Namespace MakesCentsBackend.Controllers Classes AccountController Controller for generate Account APIs, including Get All Accounts and Delete Account BankAccountController Controller for specified bank account APIs, including Create Bank Account and Update Bank Account BudgetController API controller for budgets. Persistent budget routes live directly under /api/budgets; month-specific routes live under /api/budgets/months, since a persistent budget spans many months and needs its own id space separate from any one month's. BudgetTemplateController API controller for budget templates - named, reusable presets of envelope funding amounts that can be applied to a budget month to bulk-create its funding queue. DebtAccountController EnvelopeCategoryController API controller for envelope categories EnvelopeFundingController API controller for the envelope funding queue - a budget month's plan for how much to put into each envelope and in what priority order. InvestmentAccountController PaycheckController API controller for paychecks. Paychecks are forecast-only - see EnvelopeFundingController for how envelopes actually get funded. PaymentTransactionController PlannedExpenseController API controller for planned expenses RolloverEnvelopeController API controller for rollover envelopes. Create/Update/Delete act on the persistent definition; Get is month-scoped, since a rollover envelope's planned/remaining amounts are specific to one budget month. SinkingFundEnvelopeController API controller for sinking fund envelopes TransactionController API controller for transactions TransferTransactionController UserController API controller for users

api/MakesCentsBackend.Models.html.summary: Namespace MakesCentsBackend.Models Classes AccountEntityModel Model for an abstract account ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest Request model to apply a template to a budget month, bulk-creating/updating that month's envelope funding queue from the template's entries BankAccountEntityModel Model for a bank account BankAccountSummaryDTOModel DTO model for getting all accounts BaseIdRequest BaseIdResponse Base Response for a create or edit function BaseResponse A base response model with only a status and message BudgetEntityModel Entity model for a budget BudgetTemplateEntityModel Model for a budget template - a named, reusable preset of envelope funding amounts (e.g. "Summer", "Holiday") that can be applied to a budget month to bulk-create its funding queue. Templates aren't tied to any specific month - their envelope entries reference persistent envelopes, not a month's instance of one. BudgetTemplateEnvelopeLookupModel Internal helper: one template envelope entry as read back for applying it to a month - not exposed to the API directly. CreateAccountRequest CreateAccountResponse Response model for an account CreateBankAccountRequest Request model for creating a bank account model CreateBankAccountResponse Response model for creating a bank account CreateBudgetMonthRequest Request model for creating a new month under an existing persistent budget CreateBudgetRequest Request model for creating the persistent budget entity (no month yet - see CreateBudgetMonthRequest) CreateBudgetTemplateRequest Request model to create a budget template. No envelopes here yet - use SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesRequest to add/edit its entries afterward. CreateDebtAccountRequest Request model for creating a debt account model CreateDebtAccountResponse Response model for creating a debt account CreateEnvelopeCategoryRequest Request model for creating an envelope category CreateInvestmentAccountRequest Request model to create an investment account CreateInvestmentAccountResponse Response model for creating an investment account CreatePaycheckRequest Request model to create a paycheck CreatePaymentTransactionRequest Request model to create a new payment transaction CreatePaymentTransactionResponse Response model for creating a payment transaction CreateRolloverEnvelopeRequest Request class for creating a rollover envelope's persistent definition CreateSinkingFundEnvelopeRequest Request class for creating a sinking fund envelope CreateTransactionRequest Request model to create a new transaction CreateTransactionSplitRequest Request model for creating a new transaction split CreateTransferTransactionRequest Request model to create a new transfer transaction CreateTransferTransactionResponse DebtAccountEntityModel Model for a debt account DebtAccountSummaryDTOModel EditBudgetMonthRequest Request model for updating a specific budget month's month/year (e.g. correcting a month created under the wrong month/year) EditBudgetRequest Request model for updating a budget's persistent fields (currently just the name) EditBudgetTemplateRequest Request model to rename a budget template EditEnvelopeCategoryRequest Request model for editing an envelope category EditUserRequest Request model for editing a user EnvelopeCategoryEntityModel Model for an envelope category EnvelopeFundingEntityModel Model for a single envelope funding row - one envelope's planned funding amount and priority order for a specific budget month. This is a plan, not a money movement - actual money still moves into envelopes via transactions. EnvelopeId is a display/API-level id - IsSinkingFund says whether it refers to a sinking_fund_envelope_id or the persistent rollover_envelope_id (not the month-specific rollover_envelope_month_id, which is an internal DAO detail). FindUserResponse GetAccountBaseModel Base class for getting a specific account GetAllAccountsResponse Response model for getting all accounts GetAllBudgetTemplatesResponse GetAllEnvelopeCategoriesResponse Response model for getting all envelope categories GetAllPaychecksResponse GetAllTransactionsDTOResponse GetAllTransactionsEntityResponse GetBankAccountDTOModel DTO model to get a specific bank account GetBankAccountDTOResponse Response model for getting a specific bank account GetBankAccountEntityModel Entity model to get a specific bank account GetBankAccountEntityResponse Response model for getting a specific bank account GetBudgetMonthDTOModel DTO model for sending a budget month to the API GetBudgetMonthResponse Response model for getting a budget month GetBudgetRequest Shared lookup key: a user id plus a year/month anchor point. GetBudgetTemplateDTOModel GetBudgetTemplateEnvelopeDTOModel Model for a single envelope entry within a budget template. EnvelopeId is a display/API-level id - IsSinkingFund says whether it refers to a sinking_fund_envelope_id or the persistent rollover_envelope_id. RemainingAmount/RolloverEnvelopeMonthId are null if not yet activated for that month. Planned funding for the month lives on envelope_funding, not here. GetRolloverEnvelopeDTOModel DTO model to get a specific rollover envelope for a given month GetRolloverEnvelopeDTOResponse Response model for getting a specific rollover envelope GetRolloverEnvelopeEntityModel Entity model for getting a specific rollover envelope GetRolloverEnvelopeEntityResponse Entity response model for getting a specific rollover envelope GetRolloverEnvelopeMonthRequest Request used to look up a rollover envelope in the context of one specific budget month. Built server-side from the route/JWT, same as BaseIdRequest - not sent by the client directly. GetSinkingFundDependentsResponse Response model for the rollover envelopes that use a sinking fund as their transfer target GetSinkingFundEnvelopeBaseModel Base fields returned for a sinking fund envelope GetSinkingFundEnvelopeDTOModel DTO model to get a specific sinking fund envelope GetSinkingFundEnvelopeDTOResponse Response model for getting a specific sinking fund envelope GetSinkingFundEnvelopeEntityModel Entity model for getting a specific sinking fund envelope GetSinkingFundEnvelopeEntityResponse Entity response model for getting a specific sinking fund envelope GetTransactionDTOModel GetTransactionEntityModel GetTransactionSplitDTOModel GetTransferTransactionDTOModel GetTransferTransactionDTOResponse GetTransferTransactionEntityModel Entity model for a specific transfer transaction. TransferFromEnvelopeId/ToEnvelopeId and their IsSinkingFund flags are only populated (via a follow-up transaction_split lookup) when TransferTransactionType is Envelope - they aren't columns on transfer_transaction itself. GetTransferTransactionEntityResponse GetUserBudgetsResponse Response model for every budget a user has access to GetUserDTOModel DTO model for getting a user GetUserResponse GetYearBudgetDTOModel GetYearBudgetsResponse InvestmentAccountEntityModel Model for an investment account InvestmentAccountSummaryDTOModel LoginRequest Request model for a user LoginResponse Response model for the login process PaycheckEntityModel Model for a paycheck. Forecast-only - a paycheck no longer funds envelopes directly (see envelope_funding for that) and isn't tied to any specific month. It exists purely to represent expected income on a recurring schedule. PaymentTransactionEntityModel Model for a payment transaction PaymentTransactionSnapshotModel Internal helper: the current account_id/total_amount/budget_month_id for a payment transaction, read before an update is applied so the old account-balance effect can be reversed and the new one applied cleanly. RegisterRequest RegisterResponse Response model for registration RolloverEnvelopeDependentModel A rollover envelope that sweeps into a given sinking fund envelope RolloverEnvelopeEntityModel Model for a rollover envelope's persistent definition. No dollar amounts live here - a rollover envelope isn't guaranteed to be active every month, so amounts live on the per-month instance (see RolloverEnvelopeMonthEntityModel). RolloverEnvelopeMonthEntityModel Model for a single month's instance of a rollover envelope. Absence of a row for a given (RolloverEnvelopeId, BudgetMonthId) pair means the envelope was inactive that month. SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopeItemRequest Request model for a single item within a template's envelope list being set. BudgetTemplateEnvelopeId is null for a brand new entry, or the existing entry's id to update it in place. SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesRequest Request model to set (create/reorder/update/remove all at once) a template's envelope entries. The list's order is the funding priority for whenever this template is applied. SetEnvelopeFundingItemRequest Request model for a single item within a funding queue being set. EnvelopeFundingId is null for a brand new row, or the existing row's id to update it in place. SetEnvelopeFundingQueueRequest Request model to set (create/reorder/update/remove all at once) the funding queue for a budget month. The list's order is the funding priority - item 0 is funded first. SinkingFundEnvelopeEntityModel Model for a sinking fund envelope. Sinking fund envelopes are persistent - one row holds a live remaining_amount that carries forward month to month, unlike rollover envelopes. SummaryAccountDTOModel SummaryBudgetResponse Response model for a single budget in a user's budget list - just enough to let them pick which one to open, before any month/id is known. SummaryBudgetTemplateResponse Response model for a single template in a budget's template list SummaryEnvelopeCategoryResponse Response model for an envelope category for the Get Budget method SummaryEnvelopeResponse Response model for a single envelope for the Get Budget method. Sinking fund and rollover envelopes come from two different tables with two different id spaces, so IsSinkingFund tells the frontend which table EnvelopeId belongs to (same pattern SummaryAccountDTOModel uses to distinguish bank/debt/investment accounts). RemainingAmount is nullable because a rollover envelope may not be activated for the month being viewed. SummaryPaycheckResponse SummaryTransactionDTOModel SummaryTransactionEntityModel TransactionEffectSnapshotModel Internal helper: what a transaction currently does to account balances, plus whether it is soft-deleted. Used by the delete/restore methods to reverse or re-apply its effect. TransactionEntityModel Model for an abstract transaction TransactionSplitEntityModel Model for a transaction split model. EnvelopeId is a display/API-level id - IsSinkingFund says whether it refers to a sinking_fund_envelope_id or the persistent rollover_envelope_id (not the month-specific rollover_envelope_month_id, which is an internal DAO detail). TransactionSplitSnapshotModel Internal helper: the raw current state of one transaction_split row, used to reverse its old effect on an envelope's remaining amount before an update applies the new one. TransactionSplitTransferSideModel Internal helper for reading one side of an envelope-to-envelope transfer back out of transaction_split (used by TransferTransactionDAO/TransactionDAO, not exposed to the API). TransferTransactionEntityModel Model for a transfer transaction. v3's transfer_transaction table only carries account columns - an envelope-to-envelope transfer is a transfer_transaction row of type Envelope with null account columns, paired with two opposite-signed transaction_split rows that carry the actual envelope references. TransferTransactionSnapshotModel Internal helper: the current type/accounts/total_amount/budget_month_id for a transfer transaction, read before an update is applied so the old effect (account balances or envelope remaining amounts, depending on type) can be reversed and the new one applied. api/MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAcces.summary: Class BudgetTemplateDAO Namespace MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAccessLayer Assembly MakesCentsBackend.dll Data access object for budget templates - named, reusable presets of envelope funding amounts that can be applied to a budget month to bulk-create its funding queue. public class BudgetTemplateDAO Inheritance object BudgetTemplateDAO Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Constructors BudgetTemplateDAO(MySqlConnection, AuthorizationService, RolloverEnvelopeDAO, EnvelopeFundingDAO) Parameterized constructor to bring in DI variables public BudgetTemplateDAO(MySqlConnection connection, AuthorizationService authService, RolloverEnvelopeDAO rolloverEnvelopeDAO, EnvelopeFundingDAO envelopeFundingDAO) Parameters connection MySqlConnection authService AuthorizationService rolloverEnvelopeDAO RolloverEnvelopeDAO envelopeFundingDAO EnvelopeFundingDAO Methods ApplyBudgetTemplateAsync(ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest) DAO method to apply a template to a budget month as a standalone call. Thin wrapper around ApplyBudgetTemplateWithinTransactionAsync that owns its own transaction - see that method for what actually happens. public Task<GetEnvelopeFundingQueueResponse> ApplyBudgetTemplateAsync(ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest apply) Parameters apply ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest Returns Task<GetEnvelopeFundingQueueResponse> ApplyBudgetTemplateWithinTransactionAsync(ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest, MySqlTransaction) Core logic for applying a template to a budget month, runs inside a transaction the CALLER owns (doesn't commit/rollback itself) - so it can be reused by BudgetDAO to make "create a budget month" and "apply its template" one atomic operation. This ALWAYS fully replaces that month's existing funding queue - it does not merge with or preserve whatever was there before. Records which template was applied on budget_month.budget_template_id. public Task<BaseResponse> ApplyBudgetTemplateWithinTransactionAsync(ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest apply, MySqlTransaction dbTransaction) Parameters apply ApplyBudgetTemplateRequest dbTransaction MySqlTransaction Returns Task<BaseResponse> CreateBudgetTemplateAsync(CreateBudgetTemplateRequest) DAO method to create a budget template. Cascades to remove its envelope entries. Any budget_month that had this template applied keeps its funding queue, but its budget_template_id is set back to null (the record of "which template" is lost, the funding queue itself is not). public Task<BaseResponse> DeleteBudgetTemplateAsync(BaseIdRequest request) Parameters request BaseIdRequest Returns Task<BaseResponse> GetAllBudgetTemplatesAsync(BaseIdRequest) DAO method to get every template for a budget public Task<GetAllBudgetTemplatesResponse> GetAllBudgetTemplatesAsync(BaseIdRequest request) Parameters request BaseIdRequest Returns Task<GetAllBudgetTemplatesResponse> GetBudgetTemplateAsync(BaseIdRequest) DAO method to get a single budget template, including its envelope entries public Task<GetBudgetTemplateResponse> GetBudgetTemplateAsync(BaseIdRequest request) Parameters request BaseIdRequest Returns Task<GetBudgetTemplateResponse> SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesAsync(SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesRequest) DAO method to set (create/reorder/update/remove all at once) a template's envelope entries. Existing rows not present in the incoming list are deleted. Rows with a BudgetTemplateEnvelopeId are updated in place Rows without one are inserted new. order_index is reassigned by each item's position in the incoming list - kept rows are first bumped into a high temporary range before being written back to their final low value, since unique_template_order is checked immediately (not deferred) and a straight reorder could otherwise collide with another row's still-current value. Also enforces that the same envelope can't appear twice in one template (unique_template_envelope_sinking / unique_template_envelope_rollover). public Task<GetBudgetTemplateResponse> SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesAsync(SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesRequest templateEnvelopes) Parameters templateEnvelopes SetBudgetTemplateEnvelopesRequest Returns Task<GetBudgetTemplateResponse> UpdateBudgetTemplateAsync(EditBudgetTemplateRequest) DAO method to rename a budget template public Task<BaseIdResponse> UpdateBudgetTemplateAsync(EditBudgetTemplateRequest template) Parameters template EditBudgetTemplateRequest Returns Task<BaseIdResponse>

api/MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAcces.summary: Namespace MakesCentsBackend.Services.DataAccessLayer Classes AccountDAO AuthorizationService BankAccountDAO Data access object for bank accounts BudgetDAO BudgetTemplateDAO Data access object for budget templates - named, reusable presets of envelope funding amounts that can be applied to a budget month to bulk-create its funding queue. DebtAccountDAO EnvelopeCategoryDAO Data access object for envelope categories EnvelopeFundingDAO Data access object for the envelope funding queue - a budget month's plan for how much to put into each envelope and in what priority order. This is a plan only; it doesn't move money on its own the way a transaction does. InvestmentAccountDAO PaycheckDAO Data access object for paychecks. Paychecks are forecast-only now - they don't fund envelopes directly (see EnvelopeFundingDAO for that) and aren't tied to any specific month, so this is plain single-table CRUD. PaymentTransactionDAO RolloverEnvelopeDAO Data access object for rollover envelopes. Rollover envelopes are split across two tables: rollover_envelope: the persistent definition (name, category, default transfer target). No dollar amounts live here since a rollover envelope isn't guaranteed to be active every month. rollover_envelope_month: the amounts for one specific month. Absence of a row here means the envelope wasn't activated that month. Most "get/update amount" operations need a budget_month_id in addition to the envelope id. SinkingFundEnvelopeDAO Data access object for sinking fund envelopes. Sinking fund envelopes are persistent - one row per envelope, with a live remaining_amount that carries forward month to month (no monthly instance table, unlike rollover envelopes).
